headline: Lighthouse now enforces the stated release bar, CI truth is recorded honestly, and closeout deployment status derives from the right source of truth.

items.title: S268 CI truth confirmed
items.insight: The remote evidence now separates green E2E/Lighthouse workflows from the unrelated Cloudflare Worker token-scope failure, preventing a false local-code regression narrative.

items.title: Lighthouse release bar tightened
items.insight: Performance is no longer an advisory warning; the CI contract now blocks below the S269 release threshold while preserving strict accessibility, best-practices, and SEO floors.

items.title: Threshold drift guard shipped
items.insight: Startup smoke now self-validates the Lighthouse release-bar contract, so a future config relaxation fails locally before it reaches release gates.

items.title: Closeout live deployment truth fixed
items.insight: The closeout board now falls back to PROJECT_STATUS live URL and vault status, preventing this SPARKED website from being mislabeled preview or pre-deploy when registry context is absent.

followUps: Repair or replace CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN with R2 Bucket Read/Edit for vaultspark-rum, then rerun Worker deploy.
Add route-tier Lighthouse budgets so core trust routes and long-tail generated surfaces have explicit, documented floors.
Teach the CI-status beacon to distinguish completed green workflows from known token-scope deploy failures.
blockers: Cloudflare Worker deploy remains provider-token-scope gated; local code, build, and release checks are green.
